findings.description: The CHOAM setup unconditionally shuffles all 20 standard contracts and puts 18 in the bank, even while permitting Shaddam. It does not tell a Shaddam player to set aside the two Sardaukar contracts before shuffling. The later FAQ explanation presupposes set-aside contracts but never supplies that setup instruction. This leaves the optional Shaddam game incompletely configured.

source_references.support: General Shaddam clarification explicitly requires the acquisition choice to come from set-aside Sardaukar contracts; they are not initially owned.

Although located in six-player setup, this explicitly identifies setting aside two Sardaukar contracts before shuffling as an instruction on the Shaddam Leader. Only that intrinsic Leader setup fact is used, not six-player/team mechanics.

findings.suggested_correction: Add the conditional Shaddam instruction to set aside the two Sardaukar contracts before shuffling the remaining standard contracts; qualify the two-face-up/18-bank counts for that Leader exception. Keep the set-aside contracts outside his possession until acquired.

independence_statement: I am a fresh independent auditor. I read only the exact frozen iteration-11 summary, the three authorized complete text sources and necessary unannotated publisher graphics. I did not read any other summary version, earlier audit/reviewer conclusions, repair history, coverage questions/key, reader answers or grades, and did not communicate with readers. I did not edit the summary. All findings and checks were independently derived from these inputs.
scope: Original English 2023 Uprising v23-10-12, complete standard 2–4 player play including required scoring two-player Rival, optional standard CHOAM with 20 standard contracts, separate 10 Ix contracts identified only; no solo, optional Rival variants, teams, expansions or later-product mechanics.
